the repository; [Reproduce](reproduce.qmd) lists the ones the pipeline reads.

## Overview table

From [`resources/freq/manifest.json`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/resources/freq/manifest.json).

```{python}
m = pd.DataFrame(json.loads((D / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
m["columns"] = m["columns"].map(lambda v: ", ".join(v) if isinstance(v, list) else "")
L.dt(m[["resource", "file", "status", "licence", "unit", "columns", "corpus_tokens", "bytes", "url", "sha256", "notes"]], page=25,
     wrap=["licence", "unit", "columns", "notes"], hide=["sha256", "notes", "columns"])
```
